newsitem.title: NEW ZEALAND: CHH EXPECTS LIFT IN NEXT THREE QUARTERS.
newsitem.headline: CHH EXPECTS LIFT IN NEXT THREE QUARTERS.

text.p: Carter Holt Harvey Ltd chief executive John Faraci said on Wednesday he expects the remaining three quarters of the current year to improve on the first quarter.
"I am not going to make specific forecasts at this time for the full year. I expect the next three remaining quarters on average will be better than the first quarter," he told the annual meeting.
"Trading conditions, our internal initiatives and the recent adjustments to the New Zealand dollar will start to impact favourably over the next six to nine months."
